svg.title: Every measured slowdown, shown once
svg.desc: Each of the 5,173 independently verified public slowdowns is one individually titled, visible dot. Public test only; final holdout not run. No final winner.
svg.text: One dot is one real candidate–case more than 20% slower than Python. Hover a dot for its exact case.
Dots are genuine measured cases, not a sample or a generated workload.
Public test only; final holdout not run. No final winner.
